title: Candidate profile
description: The structured facts every stage reads. Keys prefixed with _ are notes for a human or a model and are never filled into a form. application_questions is an open map: the pipeline adds a key the first time a portal asks something new.

legal_name.description: Full legal name when it differs from first + last. Forms that ask for 'full legal name' get this.

typeahead_city.description: What to TYPE into a city autocomplete, which is often not the mailing city. This is the value that actually resolves to an option.

work_authorization.description: Plain-language status, e.g. 'F-1 OPT with EAD, authorized ~3 years'. Free text: forms phrase this a dozen ways and the model needs the underlying fact, not a checkbox.

resume_path.description: The generic resume. An absolute path here does not survive a different checkout; lib/identity.mjs re-anchors by basename, but a path relative to the repo root is better.

how_did_you_hear_about_us.description: Only answers that are TRUE belong in preference_order. An aspirational list here makes the pipeline assert something false on every form that asks.

job_account_password.description: DEPRECATED here. A password in profile.json ends up in model prompts that include the profile. Move it to login.env (gitignored, 0600).

application_questions.description: Flat map of question-key -> answer. Keys beginning with _ are notes.

require_sponsorship_when_employer_cannot.description: The OTHER branch. Both must exist, and something has to choose between them per form -- see the sponsorship check in validate_setup.mjs.

cached_answers.description: Reusable free-text answers keyed 'global:<q>' or 'job:<q>'. Grown by the pipeline, not by hand.
